Hi Linda — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise mapping to what Redwood can provide for Novomed; I've attached our internal admin_evidence_handbook.pdf for detail and a short next-steps checklist.

Summary (high level)
- What we log: auth events (console + API token usages), API key lifecycle (create/rotate/revoke), user and role lifecycle (create/update/delete), privilege elevation / temporary role grants, RBAC policy changes, model deployment and version rollouts, tenant-level config changes, operator actions (start/stop nodes, scaling events), IAM integrations (SAML/SCIM events), and admin console sessions (IP + user-agent).
- Per-event metadata: timestamp (UTC), actor (internal user/email or service account), actor_ip, request_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, pre/post change snapshot (where applicable), request_payload_ref (redacted link), and result status.
- Retention: default retention is 13 months for admin/action logs. Contractual extensions: 1, 3, and 7 year retention options available via addendum. We can provide per-tenant retention policies; longer retention requires written request and may incur storage fees.
- Exports / transport: exports available as JSONL or Parquet, gzipped; large bundles delivered via presigned S3 URL or push to customer SFTP. For attestated delivery we produce an accompanying manifest (SHA256 checksums for each file) and a signed HMAC over the manifest using an infra key (customer-provided KMS options also supported).
- Integrity & chain-of-custody: every export set includes a manifest.json with file checksums, timestamp, byte counts, and a manifest signature. We can provide transfer logs (who pulled/accepted bundle) and an auditable custody statement.
- Redaction / filtering: exports can be filtered by event type, time range, and tenant_id. PII tokenization can be applied on export (field-level redaction or hashing) — requires agreed scrub rules.
- Sampling: yes — range-based exports (start/end timestamps) and sampling-by-event-type are supported. For very large windows we recommend snapshot + differential slices to reduce delivery size.

Turnaround & next steps
- Small scoped export (<= 7 days / <500GB): target 3 business days.
- Full month / attested bundle: target 7-10 business days (includes manifest creation + HMAC signing and QA).
- Legal/contractual: for retention >13 months we will need an addendum.

I've attached the handbook PDF and flagged the sections you mentioned. Happy to run a 30-minute handoff to your audit engineer — propose Thu 11/12 09:00–11:00 CET or Fri 11/13 14:00–16:00 CET. Which works?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head, Compliance Integrations
Redwood Inference

Hi Linda — quick follow-up with the items you asked for. I've attached a sample_manifest.json (sanitized/example fields only) to demonstrate the format; below is a short custody attestation and answers to your determinism question.

Sample custody attestation (one paragraph)
Redwood Inference attests that the attached administrative activity export was generated from our production audit ledger for the Novomed tenant, and that the bundle includes a manifest enumerating each file with SHA256 checksums and byte counts. The manifest was generated at the time of export, and the manifest signature provides cryptographic proof of the bundle's integrity and creation timestamp. Redwood preserves transfer logs for attestations of delivery and custody, and will provide signed transfer receipts upon agreed delivery.

Determinism on sampling
- Exports are deterministic for a fixed time window: if an identical query (same tenant_id, start/end timestamps, and event filters) is re-run against our ledger we will return the same canonical event set. Caveats: if events are reprocessed, or if retention/archival actions have been applied for the window in question, determinism may be affected; we will note such cases in the manifest metadata.

Next steps
1) I can drop the example manifest into your drive link and we can do a quick call to walk your engineer through the fields. Proposed times (same as before): Thu 11/12 09:30 CET or Fri 11/13 14:30 CET.
2) To cover retention beyond 13 months we'll prepare a short addendum draft for legal review — Marissa / Laura, can you pick this up?

Best,
Karthik
